Notes
Onchan District Commissioners are seeking a reliable, hardworking and motivated Refuse Operative to join their Environmental Services team.  This is an active, outdoor role that plays a vital part in maintaining the cleanliness and environmental standards of our community.   You will work as part of a team collecting domestic, commercial and public waste throughout the district. You will assist with the safe and efficient operation of refuse collection services while helping to maintain a clean and attractive environment for residents and visitors.  You will be required to wear and maintain the uniform and personal protective equipment provided, ensuring a professional appearance and high standard of service to the public. The role is physically demanding and involves working outdoors in all weather conditions, requiring a flexible approach and a commitment to delivering high standards of public service. Essential Requirements include:  Hold a full and valid driving licence; Being physically fit and capable of undertaking demanding manual work, including lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling wheeled bins, and walking considerable distances throughout the working day; Being comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions and occasionally in challenging environments; Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills; Be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing; Remain calm, professional and effective when working under pressure; Demonstrate a positive, reliable and flexible approach to work;  The ability to work well as part of a team and build positive working relationships with colleagues, residents and other stakeholders.  If you enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering a high-quality public service, and are comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions, we would like to hear from you. For further information and how to apply please use the following link:
https://jobs.exceedoutsourcing.co.uk/jobs/Onchan-District-Commissioners/20081000008852013/General-Labourer---Refuse?source=CareerSite

Onchan District Commissioners are looking for a reliable, motivated and hardworking Street Sweeper Driver/Environmental Operative to join their Environmental Services team.  You will carry out a range of manual and mechanical cleansing duties across the district. Your work will include operating street sweeping vehicles, maintaining public spaces, responding to environmental issues such as litter, fly tipping and dog fouling, assisting with drainage and seasonal maintenance, and supporting other operational teams when required. Working both independently and as part of a team, you will help ensure the district remains clean, safe and welcoming throughout the year.  The role is physically demanding and involves working outdoors in all weather conditions, requiring a flexible approach and a commitment to delivering high standards of public service.  Essential requirements include:  Possess a full clean driving licence including Category C1; have excellent interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to undertake physically demanding outdoor work; possess a basic understanding of health and safety requirements; have a positive, reliable and self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team; be physically fit and able to work in all weather conditions.  If you enjoy practical outdoor work and are committed to maintaining high environmental standards, we encourage you to apply.  For further information and how to apply please use the following link:

Notes
We are seeking a skilled Customer Care Technician to carry out high-quality remedial and maintenance works within newly completed homes across the Isle of Man.

Please apply here - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/7893141-customer-care-technician

You will be responsible for carrying out remedial and maintenance works in occupied new homes, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and to a high standard. The role is critical to delivering excellent customer satisfaction, protecting the company’s reputation, and ensuring homes meet quality and warranty standards.

What you will be doing:

Carry out snagging, remedial, and maintenance works in occupied and newly completed homes.
Diagnose and rectify defects across a range of trades, including basic carpentry, joinery, plumbing, and finishing works.
Respond to customer care issues within agreed service levels and appointment times.
Liaise professionally with homeowners, explaining works clearly and managing expectations.
Work closely with Customer Care Coordinators to plan and prioritise works.
Ensure all works are completed to a high standard and in line with warranty requirements.
Maintain accurate records of works completed, materials used, and follow-on actions required.
Identify defects requiring specialist subcontractor involvement and escalate where appropriate.
Ensure compliance with health & safety policies and procedures at all times.
Maintain tools, materials, and company vehicle in a safe and presentable condition.
Support inspections and quality checks where required.
Promote a positive company image through professional conduct and workmanship.

What you will have:

Proven experience as a Customer Care Technician, Maintenance Technician, or Multi-skilled Tradesperson, ideally within housebuilding or residential construction.
Strong practical skills across multiple trades.
Customer-focused mindset with excellent communication skills.
Ability to work independently and manage daily workloads effectively.
High standards of workmanship and attention to detail.
Understanding of new-build defects, warranty standards, and snagging processes.
Full IOM driving licence - Full Driving License is essential to be considered.
Relevant trade qualifications are advantageous but not essential.

What's in it for you:
Competitive salary or hourly rate depending on experience.
Fuelled company van and tools provided.

Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Ensure Player Safety:
Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

The ideal candidate will hold a Level 3 Personal Training qualification as a minimum, have at least 2-3 years of hands-on coaching experience, and be confident leading group sessions of varying fitness levels. You should have a strong understanding of exercise programming, a client-first mindset, and the ability to communicate effectively in both in-person and digital environments. Experience with online coaching platforms and client check-in processes is advantageous. You must be reliable, professional, and genuinely invested in helping people transform their health and fitness. To apply, please submit a short cover letter outlining your experience and why you feel you are the right fit for this role, along with your CV and any relevant qualifications.

For more details and to apply contact 07624263746.

Akela is a small and growing premium working dog & cat food brand, based on the Isle of Man. Our award-winning grain-free foods have accumulated the below accolades amongst others:
#1 Dog Food - eDogAdvisor (over 700 reviews).
”Best Value 5* Food” - AllAboutDogFood.
Business of Distinction Awards.
Highly Commended - Best Dog Food Brand, Your Dog Magazine.
We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Advisor to:
Process orders.
Advise customers in canine & feline nutrition via telephone and e-mail.
Liaise with parcel carriers to ensure efficient delivery.
Contact current and potential stockists.
Deliver orders to local customers in our small electric van (ideal, not required - currently half a day per week).
Attend occasional shows to exhibit our products as and when required. 
Computer skills, spreadsheets, social media platforms, numeracy and literacy should all be second nature to you. You will need to work well under pressure, dealing with challenging customers at times, so a calm manner is required to avoid being anxious about any pressurised situations that may arise from time to time. We are specifically looking for enthusiastic self-motivated team-players with initiative and a fantastic work ethic. With an impeccable telephone manner and passion for pets, your advice will help puppies thrive on our sublime food resulting in glowing customer reviews. If this sounds like you and you love dogs then get in touch today!
The computer systems we are are Zendesk, Magento and Mintsoft so if you have prior experience with any of those then that would help. If you happen to have marketing, sales or IT skills you may also be able to help further in other areas as we grow.
In return we can offer:
A competitive salary.
Potential bonus for exceeding expectations.
Self-study canine nutrition training.
Discounted pet supplies.
Part-time hours.
8:30am - 3pm working hours Monday, Wednesday & Friday with 30 mins unpaid lunch (evenings, weekends & shows optional).
This role is primarily located at our Head Office in Douglas, Isle of Man. There is a relocation incentive of up to £4,400 available, terms apply.
Please submit your CV and covering letter stating why you wish to work for our business in particular. We have keen eyes for the correct usage of the English language so please use correct grammar and spelling. CVs submitted without covering letters will not be read.

For more details and to apply visit: https://uk.indeed.com/job/customer-service-advisor-04bbfa20633abdc6

Notes
Delivery Driver's play a crucial part of the team within GSF Car Parts. They are the face of our brand by delivering parts to customers and continuously providing excellent customer service. Our Delivery Drivers are important to us, giving customer feedback insights and ensuring we stay committed to delivering goods within the promised time. 
 
As a Delivery Driver, you will be responsible for contributing to overall success of a high performing organisation and promoting the Company brand through positive interaction with customers.

Main Duties include:

Delivering product to customer’s premises within a 40 mile radius.
Ensure high levels of customer service at all times.
Feedback to branch on relevant customer and competitor activity.
Load your vehicle according to procedures.
Collect customer returns as required.
Vehicle maintenance including carrying out daily checks.
Help in the warehouse as and when required.
Assist with Inter-Branch Transfer Deliveries as and when required.
Working hours:

41 (average) hours Monday to Friday, including alternate Saturday working.

What you'll need to succeed:

Must hold a full UK Driving Licence with a maximum of 6 points.
Must have a minimum of 3 years driving experience.
Excellent knowledge of 40 mile radius of branch.
Previous experience within a delivery driver role.
Ability to understand necessity of excellent standards of customer service.
Work to deadlines with good time keeping skills.
Customer focused, driven to achieve and willing to go the extra mile.
What we'll offer:

Benefits at GSF Car Parts are designed to support all aspects of our team members life throughout their career. Whether that’s their health, wealth or everyday lifestyle, we are here for our team members and their loved ones and there is something for everyone! To name a few of our benefits we offer:

28 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus the opportunity to earn up to 5 more with time-served.
Free flu vaccine.
Health & wellbeing tools.
Free support from pension experts .
Life assurance scheme.
Discounts from 100’s of household names including Asda, Nike & John Lewis.
A suite of financial wellbeing products including advances and savings schemes. 
Paid time off to volunteer.
Training qualifications and career progression opportunities.

For more details and to apply contact brian.clarke@gsfgroup.com

Key Responsibilities
As a Delivery Driver and Warehouse Operative at Pacesetter, you will be primarily responsible for delivering orders to sites across the Isle of Man in a timely and professional manner. You will plan and organise your delivery routes efficiently to make the most of each working day, and ensure that all deliveries are correct and complete against the relevant paperwork. Back at the warehouse, you will unload incoming stock, inspect items for damage and allocate them to the correct orders, as well as providing general support across warehouse operations as needed.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must be aged 18 or over and hold a full driving licence, as this is central to the role. We are looking for someone with a positive work history and a strong record of reliable attendance. While not essential, knowledge of tiles or bathroom materials would be an advantage, as would holding a forklift licence. Above all, we are looking for someone dependable, organised and happy to turn their hand to whatever the day requires.

To find out more or to apply, please contact us by phone on 01624 622045 or by email at dan@pacesetter-ltd.com. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

A busy family in the Isle of Man is looking for a caring, reliable, and organised Nanny to help care for their children. This is a full-time role working 3 days per week on 12-hour shifts, sharing responsibilities with another Nanny to provide cover six days a week. Some weekend work and flexibility are required. 

Duties include childcare, school and nursery runs, meal preparation, homework support, organising activities, and occasional travel with the family. 

Applicants must have previous childcare experience, a full driving licence and their own vehicle, excellent English, and an enhanced DBS check. 

To apply, please send your CV to jo@recruitmentworks.im or call 629 676 for more information.

We're looking for an enthusiastic Level 3 Early Years practitioner to join our team at Dragonflies Nursery in the heart of Ramsey. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a growing, purpose-built setting dedicated to creating a nurturing and enriching environment for children.
The ideal candidate will hold a Level 3 qualification in Early Years Education, have a genuine passion for working with young children, and bring a reliable, positive attitude to everything they do.
In return, we offer a competitive salary commensurate with experience, real opportunities for professional growth, and a supportive team who care deeply about the children in their care. You'll be joining a setting that's going from strength to strength, where your contribution genuinely matters.

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team.

The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times.

Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 2 and 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position.

Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities.

Why Join Prospero Group?

We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave.  Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us.

To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.

This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.

We’re excited to offer a fantastic opportunity to join our dedicated Customer Services team. Our purpose goes far beyond policies and premiums—we’re here to support customers with clarity, confidence, and care as they navigate important decisions. If you’re passionate about delivering exceptional service and enjoy working in a dynamic, people-focused environment, this role could be a great fit for you.
As a Customer Services Administrator, you’ll be at the heart of our customer journey, owning requests end-to-end, from policy reinstatements to surrender requests. You’ll connect with customers by gathering information, providing updates, and delivering a genuinely supportive experience throughout. A key part of the role involves maintaining accurate records by updating important details in our systems with precision, as well as investigating customer queries and collaborating with colleagues to reach the best possible outcome quickly. You’ll also ensure compliance with all company and regulatory guidelines, while continuing to develop your skills through regular team meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing opportunities.
We’re looking for someone with experience in customer service within the insurance or financial services industry—this experience is essential. You’ll be warm, approachable, and a natural communicator who genuinely enjoys helping people, with strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills. You’ll be comfortable using Microsoft Office and open to learning new systems, working both independently and as part of a supportive team.

About to Graduate?  
Finishing your PhD?
What Next?

From small businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, handling complex audit procedures across the UKI industry sectors.

At EY in the Isle of Man, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.  

The opportunity:
EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026.  

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:
You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Preparing accurate assurance documentation for review.
Take ownership for nominated audit area(s) and/or delivery and completion of smaller clients.
Gaining an in-depth knowledge of the audit process to develop knowledge.
Complete work allocated by direct supervisor within budget and deadlines.
Gain knowledge on engagements of client/business issues, e.g. by using the firm's knowledge resources.
Gather and analyse data, and perform detailed audit testing.

Skills and attributes for success:
Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:

About to Graduate?  
Finishing your PhD?
What Next?

From small businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, handling complex audit procedures across the UKI industry sectors.

At EY in the Isle of Man, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.  

The opportunity:
EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026.  

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:
You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Preparing accurate assurance documentation for review.
Take ownership for nominated audit area(s) and/or delivery and completion of smaller clients.
Gaining an in-depth knowledge of the audit process to develop knowledge.
Complete work allocated by direct supervisor within budget and deadlines.
Gain knowledge on engagements of client/business issues, e.g. by using the firm's knowledge resources.
Gather and analyse data, and perform detailed audit testing.

Skills and attributes for success:
Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:
2:1 honours degree in any discipline.

To manage major and/or strategic projects through the application of best practice project management skills, tools and techniques, whilst engaging with and leading cross-functional teams to deliver scalable business solutions within the required parameters in terms of scope, cost and quality.
Conduct pre-analysis of project scope, including deliverables and timelines to determine feasibility and the potential impact of overall strategic objectives to ensure suitable amendments can be made upfront.
Drive the development of the projects change plan and the planning and implementation mechanisms for communication, training, stakeholder engagement and monitoring of change impacts to ensure solutions are effectively implemented and therefore meet the required organisational benefits.
Identify and advise on project risks through the delivery of risk reports to all stakeholders involved in the project to ensure that risk is managed appropriately. Engage with project and programme boards to ensure adequate understanding and buy in to resolve risk concerns.

Identify the most appropriate project resources, coordinate and monitor their utilisation including business resources, external consultants, contractors and other vendor resources to ensure the effective execution of project deliverables against agreed standards and timelines

Our client seeks a Reconciliations Manager to join their team. Role Profile: Lead a team to ensure that all critical financial reconciliations within the Group is done in a timely, accurate and in accord with accounting standards. In addition, to provide assistance to the subsidiaries in regard to management information and analysis. Key Responsibilities: Overseeing a team, including collaborating with key stakeholders outside of the Finance department, to ensure effective resolution of reconciling items. This includes: IT and Operations, liaising with third party suppliers and finance teams across the Group. Producing balance sheet reconciliations and ensuring unusual discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner or escalated to senior management, as applicable. Contributing to and leading the launch of new automated initiatives, including purchase and sales ledger systems, RPAs, data-analysis tools. Compiling, maintaining and updating the reconciliation matrix to ensure that all critical reconciliations are identified and performed in the Group. Reviewing reconciliations prepared by others, querying the allocation and posting of outstanding and reconciled items. Training members within the team, upskilling individuals to develop their reconciliation skills. Adhering to the month-end timetable to ensure that reconciliations are completed by. Journal posting and month-end reporting activities. Ensuring compliance with internal controls and applicable accounting framework. Processing and timely release of electronic payments whilst ensuring payment release controls are maintained. Participating in adhoc projects as required. Maintain awareness and comply with all anti-money laundering legislation, regulations, policies and procedures relevant to the Group. Comply with all policies and procedures relevant to the role. Key Skills and Experience: Part qualified accountant or actively studying towards an accounting qualification or previous relevant work experience. Excellent excel and numeracy skills. Attention to detail. Excellent communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Knowledge of ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero).

Notes
Zurich International Life Limited (ZILL) is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join its Executive Team and lead the financial management of a growing, multi-jurisdictional international insurance business. Operating across the Isle of Man, Middle East, UAE, Argentina and Hong Kong, ZILL serves expatriate, corporate and high-net-worth clients and is focused on continued growth, innovation and strong financial performance.
The CFO will play a critical role in shaping business strategy, driving financial performance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and leading finance transformation initiatives. Reporting as part of the Executive and Country Leadership teams, the role carries responsibility for financial governance, capital management, statutory and regulatory reporting, business planning, forecasting, and performance delivery across multiple jurisdictions.
The successful candidate will bring extensive senior finance leadership experience within the insurance sector, supported by a professional accounting or actuarial qualification. Deep technical expertise in areas such as IFRS 17, solvency frameworks, and finance transformation is essential, along with experience operating within complex international regulatory environments.
Beyond technical capability, ZILL is looking for a transformational leader who can modernise finance operations, optimise processes, leverage data-driven decision-making, and act as a strategic partner to the CEO, Board, and wider business. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive value, accountability and performance across the organisation will be key to success.
This is a high-impact executive opportunity to influence strategy at the highest level, lead a complex international finance function, and play a central role in driving the future growth and transformation of a globally connected insurance business.

To apply please select the link below:
https://www.careers.zurich.com/job-invite/134845/

Location: Glasgow or Isle of Man Barclays Campus with hybrid working options? 
Working Hours: You’ll work across a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, covering a mix of weekday and weekend shifts including evenings, nights and occasional afternoons to support global client needs. 
About the Role: 
We’re growing our team to better support our global market clients, extending our service beyond core business hours to meet their everyday banking needs.  
Join us as a Customer Service Advisor and be part of this next phase of growth.  
In this role, you’ll deliver a great experience for our clients as their first point of contact.  You’ll support them with their everyday banking needs, building strong relationships, developing your skills and growing your knowledge in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
To apply - 
https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Glasgow-Campus/Customer-Service-Advisor--24-7-shift-pattern_JR-0000117716

Shift Pattern: 

Rotation across day, evening and overnight shift, including a mix of weekdays and weekend working. 
Typical shift times range between 20:00 – 06:30 and 22:15 – 09:00, with some afternoon and evening shifts (14:00 – 23:45). 
Built on an 8-week rotational cycle to provide variety and fairness across shifts.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Delivering client service across telephony and written channels. 
Building, trusted relationships by understanding needs and responding with empathy and professionalism. 
Supporting clients with their banking products and services, offering solutions that meet their circumstances. 
Listening carefully to understand and provide clear, accurate, and timely support. 
Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver a consistent, high?quality experience.
Following policies and processes to maintain a strong risk and control environment.

jobs.fullDescription:
Vacancy Information
Reference ID
221736

Settlements Administrator/Analyst (Investments)
Number Required
1
Firm
Nedbank Private Wealth

31 July 2026
Notes
The Settlements Analyst will undertake the tasks carried out by the Settlements Team as allocated. The Settlements Team is responsible for the timely settlement of all investment transactions for the bank’s clients and our internal Treasury Department.

Responsibilities & Duties.
Trade settlement in multiple currencies across international markets.
Preparing documents and processing stock transfers.
Journal input and foreign exchange transactions.
Multi-currency cash and stock reconciliation query resolution.
Cross-training throughout the Settlements Team.
User Acceptance Testing for the Settlements Team, as and when required.
Proposing change in order to improve existing processes and systems.
Ensuring any settlement team errors or breaches are resolved promptly, with the required incident reporting and breach reporting completed timely and improvements identified to prevent reoccurrence.
Ensure procedures are kept up to date, as appropriate.
Ensure that any queries received are dealt with in a timely and appropriate manner keeping in regular communication with clients/relationship managers and updating them with regard to latest developments and progress towards the resolution of queries. Escalating where appropriate.
Undertaking ad hoc tasks as directed by the Settlements Manager.
Keep updating knowledge regarding international business policies and changes within the industry.
Keeping up to date with regulatory changes within the industry and ensuring measures are taken to comply.
Assist in project work as assigned by the Settlements Manager, delivering to any set timescales.
Provide support to the Settlements Manager and other team members.
Providing cover for other areas within the department where training has been received.
To safeguard client assets by ensuring client asset rules are followed for all appropriate jurisdictions.
?

Skills, Qualifications and Experience.
A minimum of two years in an investment operations role (desirable).
To have a good knowledge of investment administration activities, both technical and operational, with the ability to detect possible problems and provide solutions.
Previous experience in a dealing or settlements role would be advantageous but not necessary.
A minimum of 5 GCSE’s or equivalent, with a pass at grade C or higher, in Maths and English.
Holds or working towards a suitable investment administration qualification at level 3 or above, such as the CISI Investment Operations Certificate (IOC) or an equivalent investment related qualification.

Apply via our careers portal: http://nedbank.peoplehr.net/Pages/JobBoard/Opening.aspx?v=5a70cb20-e823-4377-83fb-6e4eafa17d80

Notes
Gardener / Estate Maintenance Operative.

Steward & Hive Property Services is looking for a reliable, hardworking and enthusiastic **Gardener / Handyman** to join our growing team.

This is a **permanent position** with **30 hours per week guaranteed**, with the opportunity to increase to **full-time (40 hours)** as the business continues to grow. An immediate start is available for the right candidate.

 The Role:

You'll be working across a variety of residential and commercial properties carrying out:
Grass cutting and lawn maintenance,
Strimming and edging,
Hedge cutting and pruning,
General garden maintenance and tidy-ups,
Basic property maintenance and handyman tasks,
Safe operation and routine care of gardening equipment,

Essential Requirements:

Previous experience using **strimmers, lawn mowers, hedge cutters, leaf blowers and similar equipment**,
Full, clean driving licence,
Reliable, punctual and able to work independently,
Physically fit and happy working outdoors in all weather conditions,
A positive attitude and pride in producing high-quality work,

Desirable:

Previous gardening, grounds maintenance or landscaping experience,
Basic handyman or property maintenance skills,

What We Offer:

Guaranteed **30 hours per week**, with the aim of increasing to **40 hours** as we secure new contracts,
Typical working hours between **9:00am and 5:00pm**, Monday to Friday (some flexibility may be required),
Company van provided during working hours,
Competitive rate of pay, depending on experience,
Varied work across some of the Isle of Man's finest homes and estates,
The opportunity to grow with an ambitious and expanding business.

If you'd like to join a friendly, professional team and help us deliver exceptional property and garden care across the Isle of Man, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a brief summary of your experience to hello@hive.co.im or message us directly for more information.

You’ll also be involved in routine maintenance tasks including isolating and recharging mains, flushing systems, and detecting and preventing water loss, while ensuring high standards of customer service, environmental responsibility, and safety.
The ideal candidate will be a positive team player with experience in groundworks or civil works and a strong commitment to health, safety and wellbeing. You should be organised, dependable, and capable of working from risk assessments and method statements. Good basic literacy and numeracy skills are essential, along with the ability to work in physically demanding environments, including confined spaces. A sound knowledge of the Island’s geography and a proactive, collaborative approach will help you succeed in this varied and rewarding role.

For further information and to apply, please visit https://www.manxutilities.im/careers/vacancies/

Viva Heights is looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate, and experienced Senior Support Worker to join our dedicated team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about providing high-quality, person-centred support and leading by example within a supportive residential care environment.
As a Senior Support Worker, you will play a key role in supporting individuals with complex needs to live fulfilling and meaningful lives while promoting independence, choice, dignity, and wellbeing. You will provide guidance and supervision to support staff, ensure high standards of care are maintained, and work closely with colleagues, families, and professionals to achieve positive outcomes for the people we support.

Lead and support staff on shift, promoting safe and effective care practices.
Provide high-quality, person-centred support tailored to individual needs.
Act as a positive role model, mentor, and supervisor to support workers.
Support the implementation and review of care plans, risk assessments, and support strategies.
Maintain accurate records and complete reports to a high standard.
Promote the safety, wellbeing, independence, and rights of the individuals we support.
Liaise effectively with families, healthcare professionals, and other agencies.
Respond calmly and confidently to complex situations and support staff in problem-solving.
Contribute to a positive team culture and continuous service improvement.

We are looking for someone who has:
A minimum of 2 years' experience working as a Senior Support Worker within a care setting.
GCSE-level education or equivalent.
A QCF Level 3 in Care (or currently working towards this qualification).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
The ability to motivate, supervise, and support others.
Experience working with individuals who have complex needs.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively.
Effective organisational skills, including the ability to delegate and manage workloads.
Practical care skills and a person-centred approach.
The ability to build positive working relationships and work effectively as part of a team or independently.
Eligibility
Please note: This position is not open to off-Island applicants. Applicants must already be living in the Isle of Man and hold the appropriate right to work and visa status to work within the Island.
How to Apply
To apply, please send a brief covering letter outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the role to managervivaheights@vivavest.uk
Closing Date: 24.07.2026.

Viva Heights is looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate, and experienced Senior Support Worker to join our dedicated team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about providing high-quality, person-centred support and leading by example within a supportive residential care environment.
As a Senior Support Worker, you will play a key role in supporting individuals with complex needs to live fulfilling and meaningful lives while promoting independence, choice, dignity, and wellbeing. You will provide guidance and supervision to support staff, ensure high standards of care are maintained, and work closely with colleagues, families, and professionals to achieve positive outcomes for the people we support.

Lead and support staff on shift, promoting safe and effective care practices.
Provide high-quality, person-centred support tailored to individual needs.
Act as a positive role model, mentor, and supervisor to support workers.
Support the implementation and review of care plans, risk assessments, and support strategies.
Maintain accurate records and complete reports to a high standard.
Promote the safety, wellbeing, independence, and rights of the individuals we support.
Liaise effectively with families, healthcare professionals, and other agencies.
Respond calmly and confidently to complex situations and support staff in problem-solving.
Contribute to a positive team culture and continuous service improvement.

A minimum of 2 years' experience working as a Senior Support Worker within a care setting.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
The ability to motivate, supervise, and support others.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively.
Effective organisational skills, including the ability to delegate and manage workloads.

Notes
Salary up to £75,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 plus Relocation Allowance up to £5,000.

Are you looking for an equine-focused role that offers genuine professional fulfilment alongside an exceptional quality of life? We’re delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for an Equine Veterinary Surgeon to join our thriving practice on the beautiful Isle of Man. This is a varied and rewarding equine-only position, working within a supportive and experienced team where you’ll be encouraged to develop your clinical skills while enjoying a truly unique island lifestyle. For those considering relocation, we offer full support with moving to the Isle of Man, helping to make the transition as smooth and stress-free as possible so you can focus on settling into both your new role and your new home.

Looking for a better work–life balance?

We offer a genuinely flexible approach to working patterns and welcome both full-time and part-time applicants. The full-time role is 38 hours per week, worked over 4 or 5 days, with 1 in 4 Saturday mornings and approximately 1 in 10 nights and weekends on call. Work–life balance is a genuine priority here. You’ll benefit from a competitive salary, generous holiday allowance, and strong CPD support to help you continue developing your equine interests and expertise. Our flexible rota patterns are designed to work around real life — whether that’s school commitments, reduced hours during holidays, or a working pattern that better suits your lifestyle, we’re happy to fix or flex rotas wherever possible. 

Team & Facilities:

You’ll be joining a supportive, friendly and experienced team that values collaboration, mentorship, and a positive working culture. The wider clinical team includes 17 Veterinary Surgeons, 14 Registered Veterinary Nurses, and 20 dedicated support staff, with BVRA-registered members and certificate holders within the group. This equine-only role offers a varied and rewarding caseload, combining ambulatory work in the field with access to excellent facilities and modern diagnostic equipment, enabling you to practice high-quality, progressive equine medicine. You’ll be supported by a knowledgeable team and a learning-focused environment where professional development is actively encouraged and your ideas are valued.

Life on the Isle of Man:

Set against a backdrop of rolling hills, rugged coastlines, and open countryside, the Isle of Man offers a truly special way of life. You’ll become part of a welcoming, close-knit community with a vibrant cultural scene — from the world-famous TT races and music festivals to live shows, local breweries, and a thriving food scene. With endless opportunities for outdoor pursuits, including equestrian activities, cycling, wild swimming, and fitness, it’s easy to build a life here that’s as fulfilling outside of work as it is within it.

Apply via the IVC website or contact taylor.findlay@ivcevidensia.com

Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

Associate Dentist – Full Time.
Port Erin, Isle of Man.
Monday to Friday | 8:30am – 5:00pm.

Join our growing team at Port Erin Dental Surgery.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Associate Dentist to join our busy mixed NHS and private practice in the beautiful south of the Isle of Man.

Port Erin Dental Surgery is a modern, newly refurbished practice offering excellent clinical facilities, a strong patient base, and an experienced, supportive team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a clinician looking to build a long-term career in a progressive environment.

What we offer:
Full-time position (Monday–Friday, 8:30am–5:00pm).
Established NHS list with excellent private potential.
Newly renovated, modern surgeries.
Digital workflow throughout.
Medit i700 intraoral scanner.
iTero scanner.
Digital radiography and OPG.
Experienced nursing and reception support.
Clinical freedom and supportive management.
Friendly, team-focused working environment.
Opportunity to develop in cosmetic and restorative dentistry.

About you:
GDC registered dentist.
NHS performer number (or eligibility to obtain one).
Excellent communication and patient care skills.
Motivated to provide high-quality dentistry.
Keen to grow both NHS and private patient base.

Located in one of the Isle of Man’s most scenic coastal villages, this role offers an excellent work-life balance with lower tax rates and a fantastic quality of life.

For more information or to apply, please send your CV and cover letter to Byron Tsivos at vtsivos@hotmail.com.

Free Parking.

In house training.
‘Employee Assistance Programme’ provided to all employees.
Wage enhancement for working between 05.30-07.30 am - an extra £2 per hour.

Notes
We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island.

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role:
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
What You'll Be Doing:
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You:
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer:
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply:
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im

Notes
Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.
We are looking for a Baker / Customer server to join our small team who has a cheerful and welcoming personality. We start early and finish early which is great, as you have the rest of the day to yourself. The job would be ideal for someone who loves cooking, helping customers and enjoys variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

Your role will be to prepare our daily Croissants, Home Made Cakes in our kitchen in the mornings, alongside our team, serve our lovely customers with their lunches at lunchtime and clearing after service. Home Made Cake baking experience will be particulary welcomed. Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 6.30 / 7.00 am to 3.00 pm (Mon – Fri), approx. 38 hours p.w. This is a Monday – Friday permanent day time role (i.e. non-seasonal).

An excellent standard and understanding of verbal and written English is required to enable instructions from customers to be completed accurately. 

We would welcome applications from experienced individuals, however we can also train you in any areas required. Barista experience, telephone experience and a full driving licence would be welcomed. 

Our business is geared to the corporate market and therefore our food must always go out on time, which means we need 100% reliability with your time keeping and attendance. You’ll be bright, smart, professional and clean in your appearance.  Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please either e-mail your CV to callum@tastebuds.im, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form. If you would like to know more about the role, please telephone Callum on 615516 after 2.00 pm. If you have not heard from us within 14 days, please assume your application has not been successful.

We are looking for a Trainee IT & Print Engineer to join our team and develop a career within IT, print technology and technical services. No previous engineering experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in technology.

What you will be doing:

Preparing and configuring printers and other devices before customer installation.
Delivering and installing equipment across the Isle of Man.
Supporting toner and consumables management for customers.
Assisting with the preparation and deployment of laptops and Apple devices.
Receiving, checking and organising stock within the warehouse.
Supporting inventory control and stocktake activities.
Learning our service desk and ticket management systems.
Providing excellent customer service both on-site and over the phone.

Typical working hours are a 37.5-hour week Monday to Friday.

A keen interest in IT and technology.
Good practical and problem-solving skills.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally a full driving licence.

What we offer:

Full training and ongoing support.
Manufacturer training with leading technology providers.
Opportunity to attend specialist training courses in the UK.
Exposure to a wide range of IT and print technologies.
Genuine career progression into technical engineering roles.
A varied role where no two days are the same.

This role would suit a college leaver, someone looking to start a career in IT or engineering, or an individual with customer service or technical experience who is looking for a new challenge.

Notes
Are you an experienced Environment Manager looking to take ownership of a complex, business critical technology landscape?

IFGL is seeking an Environment Manager to lead the governance, planning and operational management of our development, test and pre-production environments across both on premise and Azure cloud platforms. Reporting to the Head of IT Delivery, you will play a key role in enabling reliable, high-quality software delivery across multiple products, teams and suppliers. 

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Define, own and evolve IFGL's environment management strategy and roadmap.
Manage the full lifecycle of development, test and pre-production environments.
Ensure environments are stable, available and ready to support delivery, testing and release activities.
Coordinate environment demand, scheduling and capacity across multiple teams and suppliers.
Drive standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across the environment estate.
Work closely with DevOps, Testing, Architecture, Infrastructure and third-party partners to improve delivery outcomes. 
To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
Proven experience managing complex IT environments across multiple platforms and suppliers.
Strong understanding of environment lifecycle management, SDLC and software delivery practices.
Experience supporting Agile and Waterfall delivery teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, planning and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure environments, including Azure cloud technologies. 

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

Closing date for this vacancy will be 23 July 2026.

As a Test Analyst, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our systems work as intended before they go live. You’ll be involved in reviewing requirements, designing test scenarios, executing tests, and reporting results. You’ll get the opportunity to be involved in projects throughout the software development lifecycle and to help build in quality. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software testing and develop your technical and analytical skills.

The main duties for this role are:

Review & testing sign-off of requirements and design specifications.
Creation of formal test documentation, including Test Plans and Completion Reports.
Test design, execution, defect management & monitoring.
Ensuring full traceability of testing to requirements/specification.
Progress reporting to Test Lead/Manager and project stakeholders.
Creation of re-useable, automatable, test cases for regression.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate should have the following skills and experience:

Strong analytical & problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal.
Ability to work collaboratively, or on your own initiative, and deliver to tight deadlines.
Experience with using Gherkin syntax for test case design.
ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing.
Minimum 2 years’ experience of testing.
Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular, is an advantage.
Experience of test automation is an advantage.
A genuine interest in technology and software testing.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com.

As a Test Automation Analyst, you will play a key role in helping IFGL build and mature its automation capability during an exciting period of technology transformation. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing solutions across our applications and platforms, ensuring quality is built into the delivery process from the outset.

The main duties for this role are:

Review requirements, specifications, and solution designs to ensure appropriate test coverage.
Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts for UI, API, and backend testing.
Create reusable and maintainable automated test assets to support regression testing.
Integrate automated testing into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. 
Execute automated and manual testing activities where appropriate. 
Manage defects, analyse root causes, and work collaboratively with delivery teams to resolve issues. 
Ensure full traceability of testing activities against requirements and specifications. 
Produce test reports and provide progress updates to Test Leads, Managers, and project stakeholders. 
Create and maintain formal test documentation, including test plans, completion reports, framework documentation, and testing standards. 
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and promote automation best practices across the organisation.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate should have the following skills and experience:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment as well as independently when required. 
Experience developing automated tests using C#, .NET, and NUnit. 
Experience using Playwright for web UI automation. 
Experience working with APIs and backend testing techniques. 
Knowledge of SQL for test data validation and database testing. 
Experience working with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and source control systems. 
Familiarity with PowerShell scripting. 
Good understanding of test automation frameworks, methodologies, and best practices. 
Experience producing test documentation and reporting on testing progress and outcomes. 
Exposure to the Finance sector and Life & Pensions industry would be advantageous. 
ISTQB Certification would be advantageous. 
A genuine interest in technology, software quality, and test automation.

As a Test Lead, you will take responsibility for leading testing activities to ensure quality and reliability across IFGL’s technology landscape. This role ensures adherence to testing standards, collaborates with development and change teams, and drives continuous improvement to deliver secure, high-quality releases. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead software testing teams on a variety of challenging & interesting projects.

The main responsibilities of the role are:

Defining and executing test plans that ensure comprehensive coverage and quality, adhering to departments strategy and processes & implementing test standards and best practices across teams.
Collaborating with Development, Change and business teams to align testing with delivery objectives. Proactively helping with testing to ensure team deadlines are achieved.
Monitoring and reporting on test results, identifying trends and driving improvements, continuous improvement through adoption of new tools, techniques and automation opportunities.
Managing test environments and data to support accurate and efficient testing.
Coordination & support of UAT/BVT testing activities .
Performance management and support of direct reports.

To ensure this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate will need the following skills and experience:

Excellent planning and organisational skills, able to manage multiple workloads concurrently.
Strong analytical & problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills , ability to engage positively with & gain support from senior management/stakeholders.
Ability to work collaboratively, or on your own initiative, and deliver to tight deadlines.
Strong understanding of Gherkin syntax, peer reviews and formal reviews.
ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing is essential, ISTQB Advanced level is desirable.
Minimum 5 years experience of testing, with at least 3 years in a senior/lead role.
Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular, is an advantage.
Experience of test automation is an advantage.
A genuine interest in technology and software testing.

Notes
About the role:
You'll own the day-to-day security operations of our corporate and cloud environments: hands-on, execution-focused work securing the tools, endpoints and infrastructure our teams rely on.
You'll implement and maintain our security posture across our productivity suite, device fleet, VPN and identity stack and cloud environment.
This is a build-and-harden role for someone who likes getting into the weeds. As you grow into it, there's a clear path toward owning the security function more broadly.
What you'll do:
Corporate & endpoint security
Administer and harden our identity and access stack, including password management and VPN/network-access tooling.
Configure and enforce device policies through mobile device management - disk encryption, screen-lock, patching baselines, app control and compliance rules across the fleet.
Manage endpoint protection and keep patching and vulnerability remediation on a predictable cadence.
Harden our productivity and collaboration suite: access controls, 2FA/MFA enforcement, admin roles and data-sharing/DLP settings.
Own onboarding/offboarding from a security angle - provisioning, de-provisioning and access reviews.
Cloud security.

Harden our AWS environment: IAM policies and least-privilege access, account and organisation guardrails, security groups and network segmentation.
Implement and monitor logging and detection.
Manage secrets, key management and encryption at rest and in transit.
Review infrastructure changes for security impact and work with engineering to close gaps.
Testing & assurance.

Run internal and continuous security testing: vulnerability scanning, configuration audits and attack-surface reviews.
Conduct hands-on internal penetration testing against our own systems where appropriate.
Scope, coordinate and manage external penetration-test vendors for formal independent assessments, then track and drive remediation of findings.
Maintain security documentation, run tabletop exercises and support our compliance and audit obligations.
What we're looking for:

Proven hands-on experience in security operations, IT security or cloud security engineering - someone who has actually configured MDM, hardened AWS, and administered identity tooling, not just written policy about it.
Solid working knowledge of Cloud security services and cloud hardening.
Comfortable across at least one MDM platform, a VPN/ZTNA solution and a password-management tool.
Practical familiarity with vulnerability scanning and penetration-testing tools and methodologies.
Scripting ability (Python, Bash or similar) for automation.
A methodical, ownership-driven mindset - you close loops and document as you go.

For more details and to apply visit: https://fortunatemedia.bamboohr.com/careers/100

Notes
As Principal Network Architect at Stacuity, you will be the senior design authority for our global IP network – the underlying connectivity fabric that carries traffic between our mobile core, our edge sites, and our customers and partners worldwide.
This is a role for someone equally comfortable at the whiteboard and in the rack. You will author the High-Level and Low-Level Designs that turn business and customer requirements into resilient, ultra-high-availability network infrastructure, and you will then roll your sleeves up and work alongside our engineers to see those designs through to live deployment. You will be the technical authority other engineers turn to when something needs to be designed right the first time, and the person who steps in when something needs fixing fast.
You will work across our global footprint of edge sites, data centres, and interconnects, with direct responsibility for routing, switching, and firewall architecture, and close involvement in how our network integrates with cloud and core platform infrastructure.

You will be responsible for design and architecture, hands on delivery alongside engineers and the wider infrastructure team and providing technical leadership and mentorship to network and infrastructure engineers. 

To apply visit: https://stacuity.bamboohr.com/careers/32?source=aWQ9MjA%3D

Strong commercial acumen with excellent risk management and financial analysis capabilities. Outstanding communication and negotiation skills with ability to challenge ideas and convince stakeholders.

Notes
Our client seeks a Transaction Management Unit Manager to join their team. Role Profile: To independently implement and manage a range of complex Structured Corporate Loan transactions as intended by the loan agreement, in support of the IB business and Wholesale Clients clients. Key Responsibilities: Actively monitor, identify, investigate, resolve and / or escalate complex issues relating to the deal throughout the life of each live transaction and regularly communicate with stakeholders in order to maintain appropriate positions and efficient operations, ensure the transaction terms and conditions are adhered to by the client and / or third parties, provide a high-quality service, and mitigate operational risk. Collect and lodge all transaction collateral documentation (e.g. legal agreements, security agreements, share certificates) with the Collateral team for safe keeping and feed downstream calculations for capital management and credit risk mitigation. Coordinate with Legal, Credit and Collateral to approve and authorise various collateral (security) releases. Consult stakeholders, provide relevant operational expertise regarding complex Structured Loan transaction operational requirements into cross-functional enablement teams, provide approvals and participate in post product deployment reviews, to ensure the effective operation of new product development and smooth activations. Coordinate and inform stakeholders of the transaction close out when it reaches maturity, to ensure stakeholders are aligned, Wholesale Clients records are reliable and valid, and the capital management process is well supported. Where applicable, provide instructions to release all required collateral. Create complex transactions based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Educated to Degree Level (Business Commerce). 5 - 7 years experience in Operations. A track record adding value and delivering professional, client centric service to internal and /or external clients preferred. Experience working within Transaction Management in Financial Services supporting the Investment Banking business.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16599

Notes
Job Purpose:	
We’re looking for a confident Digital Marketing Executive that will take the reins of key marketing activity across partner, customer and internal comms for a 12-month fixed term role, helping shape how plan.com shows up in the market every day.

This role is all about turning ideas into impact. From campaigns and content to product launches and partner activity, you’ll be right at the centre of making things happen - creating marketing that gets seen, used and talked about. The ideal candidate will have experience in a high-pace, competitive environment, with the passion and drive to deliver multiple projects often to tight deadlines. A creative and strategic thinker, you’ll have the energy and drive to go the extra mile and exceed expectations.

Working closely with sales, product, design, people experience and senior leaders, you’ll take business priorities and turn them into clear, creative and commercially focused marketing across every channel. It’s a hands-on role where no two days look the same - one minute you’re shaping a campaign, the next you’re pulling together a launch, writing content, or bringing a new idea to life.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Partner Marketing:
•	Responsible for the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns to engage audiences and set plan.com apart. 
•	Lead partner marketing campaigns and enablement activity.
•	Develop and maintain sales collateral, partner tools and presentation.
•	Create partner training materials and enablement content.
•	Support development of case studies and testimonials.
•	Coordinate partner webinar communications and setup.

Campaign & Content Delivery:
•	Plan and deliver marketing campaigns across email, web and digital channels.
•	Develop and manage end-to-end marketing launch plans for products, services, and platform updates.
•	Manage customer lifecycle communications including onboarding, service updates, and change communications (from copy through to delivery).

Internal Marketing & Brand:
•	Ensure brand and messaging consistency across all channels.
•	Coordinate internal launch planning and go-to-market activity.
•	Support sales teams with battlecards, messaging, and pitch content.
•	Coordinate the advertising and PR efforts of the businesses.
•	Coordinate marketing briefs with internal teams and external agencies (design and PR) where required.
•	Support maintenance of sales SRM onboarding and data coordination.

For full details and to apply online please visit - www.plan.com/careers

Driveshare is looking for a creative, proactive Social Media Manager to grow its social media presence. You'll create engaging content, manage campaigns across multiple platforms, build and engage their online community, analyse performance, and help increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and vehicle owner sign-ups. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys creating content, stays on top of social media trends, and can work independently as part of a small remote team. The role is based in the Isle of Man - a fully remote position.

Main Purpose:

Manage and grow DRIVESHARE's social media presence.
Create engaging content and increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and vehicle owner sign-ups.

Key Responsibilities:

Plan, create, and schedule content across social media platforms.
Produce posts, stories, TikTok videos, and Instagram Reels.
Edit videos, add graphics and captions, and create visual content.
Monitor comments, messages, and community engagement.
Track social media performance using tools like Meta Business Suite and report on results.
Stay up to date with social media trends, algorithms, and new features.
Work with the marketing team to create campaigns and share customer and owner stories.

Requirements: 
Experience managing social media accounts (B2B or B2C).
Strong content creation skills (photography, videography, editing).
Good copywriting and communication skills.
Experience with scheduling, analytics, and content planning tools.
Comfortable using AI and digital tools.
Well-organised, proactive, and able to work independently in a remote team.
GCSE English (Grade C or above).
Full right to work in the Isle of Man.
Professional and detail-oriented.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys creating content, stays on top of social media trends, and can work independently as part of a small remote team. The role is based in the Isle of Man - a fully remote position.

Main Purpose:

Manage and grow DRIVESHARE's social media presence.
Create engaging content and increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and vehicle owner sign-ups.

Key Responsibilities:

Plan, create, and schedule content across social media platforms.
Produce posts, stories, TikTok videos, and Instagram Reels.
Edit videos, add graphics and captions, and create visual content.
Monitor comments, messages, and community engagement.
Track social media performance using tools like Meta Business Suite and report on results.
Stay up to date with social media trends, algorithms, and new features.
Work with the marketing team to create campaigns and share customer and owner stories.

Requirements: 
Experience managing social media accounts (B2B or B2C).
Strong content creation skills (photography, videography, editing).
Good copywriting and communication skills.
Experience with scheduling, analytics, and content planning tools.
Comfortable using AI and digital tools.
Well-organised, proactive, and able to work independently in a remote team.
GCSE English (Grade C or above).
Full right to work in the Isle of Man.
Professional and detail-oriented.

To find more about the company and to apply, please click on the link below: https://tracker.driveshare.com/careers

Our client seeks an AML & High-Risk Technical Specialist to join their first-line operational team. In this pivotal role, you will ensure robust financial crime controls, lead the assessment of higher-risk clients, and support the organisation in maintaining a strong, compliant AML/CFT framework. Key Responsibilities: Lead and enhance AML/CFT frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulations and internal policies. Conduct comprehensive CDD/KYC for higher-risk clients, including complex corporate and trust structures. Validate Source of Funds/Source of Wealth and review AML concession requests. Manage ongoing monitoring, including transaction monitoring tools and risk-based periodic reviews. Deliver AML training, support accreditation programmes, and provide day-to-day operational guidance. Analyse trends, produce MI and reports for senior committees, and contribute to Financial Crime projects. Represent the first line in AML/CFT-related projects and regulatory-driven change initiatives. Prepare high-quality submissions for the HRC and maintain the PEP and Delegated Authority Registers. Lead the Business Risk Assessment (BRA) and Technology Risk Assessment (TRA) processes. Key Skills & Experience: 5+ years' experience in regulated financial services; investment industry experience advantageous. Strong knowledge of Isle of Man AML/CFT legislation, regulation, and guidance. Expertise in analysing complex structures and delivering enhanced due diligence. Proven ability to assess higher-risk profiles, including PEPs and adverse media cases. Strong analytical, investigative, and reporting skills with excellent attention to detail.Confident communicator able to influence senior stakeholders and support operational teams.Proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Relevant professional qualifications (e.g., ICA) desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16463
